Rollout quality after training: rough (score 0.33); the behavior is only partially learned.

A drawing-robot policy: from pen pose alone it produces the constant turn and step commands of a pentagon. Inputs and outputs: Inputs: pen position, heading (sin/cos), drawing progress, base step length and target size. Outputs: turn angle and step-length scale. Rollout quality after training: excellent (score 0.62).

Inputs: pen position, heading (sin/cos), drawing progress, base step length and target size. Outputs: turn angle and step-length scale. It mostly manages the behavior, with some wobble: score 0.40 on held-out episodes.
